name: x402node

overview.text: x402node advertises 556 endpoints in 50 categories with per-call USDC payments on Base through x402, without accounts, API keys or subscriptions. It describes EIP-3009 authorization and Coinbase CDP settlement, with JavaScript and TypeScript examples; Python and MCP support remain labelled forthcoming. Examples range from $0.0022 random bytes to $0.02 signature verification and $0.08 liquidity-position math. The deterministic-tools slogan does not cover every judgment: heuristic wallet labels, risk scores and rankings are not independent safety or investment findings. Raw endpoint links require a compatible paying client, not manual browser-wallet payment.
